code:
Table: sys_user

user_name          -> login value
email               -> notifications, password reset
active               -> master login gate
locked_out           -> failed-attempt / manual lockout
password_needs_reset -> forces new password next login
caption: Agents, managers, end users, integration accounts — all one table.

steps.label: active
steps.sub: is this person a valid user at all? false blocks login completely

steps.label: locked_out
steps.sub: separate flag after failed attempts or manual security action

steps.label: password_needs_reset
steps.sub: forces a fresh password on the next successful login

code:
Delete sys_user record:
  caller_id on old incidents    -> broken/orphaned
  opened_by, assigned_to        -> broken/orphaned
  approval history              -> lost audit trail

Set active = false instead:
  person can no longer log in
  every historical reference stays intact
caption: sys_user is referenced from nearly every table in the system.
